notes:
Deal summary: POC (3 weeks) to evaluate reranking service for ad personalization. We delivered Dedicated preview, latency tests, and cost sensitivity analysis. Sales timeline was compressed after procurement required vendor consolidation. Key events:
- 2025-09-10: Intro call, Maya + Diego. Customer scoping: 20ms p95 target, 2k rps sustained, tight SSO + audit requirements. (caller: CTO Rajesh Iyer)
- 2025-10-01: POC kicked off — provided mini cluster config + prompt set. Drive: infra-cost-comparison.xlsx updated.
- 2025-11-05: Security review (infosec) — flagged KMS policy mismatch and requirement for customer-managed key rotation cadence. Raised INF-3421.
- 2025-12-08: Performance checkpoint: p95 ~28ms on Dedicated preview; acceptable but cost delta higher than expected. Shared optimization plan (batching + quantization).
- 2026-01-12: Procurement issued final RFP; customer internally prioritized vendors that unify with their cloud (heavy AWS spend).
- 2026-02-18: Verbal update from Rajesh: procurement selected AWS SageMaker real-time endpoints due to existing enterprise agreement + simplified ops. "We can't add another control plane right now". No champion remains after engineering lead left in Jan.
POC takeaways: Redwood runtime met latency targets with tuning; cost remained the decision factor combined with vendor consolidation and key rotation policy misalignment. Next actions: internal win/loss write-up, update playbook for KMS rotation compatibility, and keep light touch for 6 months (monitor if vendor issues arise).
